Contract ManageUserCRUDService::modifyUser(userid: Integer,name: String,address: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		card: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(b|b.CardID = userid)
	precondition:
		card.oclIsUndefined() = bool
	postcondition:
		if card.oclIsNew() 
		then ClassName.allInstance()->includes(card) 
		else card.CardStatus = 'SUSPEND' and
		result = true 
		endif 
}
